finding: Optional domain file reader opens path with blocking os.Open before regular descriptor admission. A FIFO with no writer can block provider startup although invalid or missing optional evidence should leave it running unsigned. Byte limit does not bound open latency.
required_fix: Open/admit nonblocking no-follow regular descriptor, finite read and immutable digest. Nonregular, missing, oversized or invalid optional input returns zero domain and diagnostic; ordinary provider admission remains independent. Avoid imposing private-key permission policy on this public domain.
deterministic_coverage: FIFO with no writer, directory/device/symlink as supported, complete-document and finite byte boundary, actual provider fallback, swarm isolation.
